verdict.rationale: The 01 documents clients for several targets: an Android & iOS app, a desktop client, and an ESP32 implementation. It also offers a Light Server for low-power devices and a Livekit Server for more capable hardware, plus hardware guides from desktop setups to ESP32 builds. However, the evidence never names which desktop OSes (macOS, Windows, Linux) the agent supports, and the mobile apps act as voice front-ends to a server running on 'your computer' rather than the agent running on each OS. Missing for 10: explicit macOS/Windows/Linux support matrix, per-OS setup and capability documentation, independent or hands-on confirmation of cross-OS operation.
